24. The driver is required to be impleaded so as to adjudicate upon negligence because the vicarious liability of the owner which insurance company is statutorily and contractually bound to indemnify stems from the negligence itself.
It is a peculiar circumstance where the entire family of driver including his wife and children is wiped out.
Further, parents of deceased driver were duly impleaded vide order dated 26.11.2021, but they chose neither to appear nor to contest the petition with allegations of negligence against their son.
